expectations.text: Badge background and text colors use var(--color-*) CSS variables, not hardcoded hex values
expectations.evidence: Lines 287-293: .status-living { background: var(--color-success-bg); color: var(--color-success-text) } and .status-deceased { background: var(--color-bg-muted); color: var(--color-text-subtle) }

expectations.text: Badge label strings ('Living', 'Deceased' or Swedish equivalents) use $t() not hardcoded text
Has NO local 'declare const window' type declaration
Does NOT redefine shared classes like .btn-add, .data-table, or .clickable-row in scoped styles
expectations.evidence: Scoped styles define only view-specific classes: .header-actions, .sex-badge, .sex-M/F/U, .status-badge, .status-living, .status-deceased, etc.
